title: GUVI: Roman to Integer Conversion
description: Given a Roman numeral string `s`, convert it to an integer. Symbol values: I: 1, V: 5, X: 10, L: 50, C: 100, D: 500, M: 1000. Subtraction rule applies when a smaller numeral precedes a larger one.
explanation: If current value is less than subsequent value, subtract it; otherwise add it. Linear O(N) time and O(1) space.
